common.appDescription: Lock a message to the future. To yourself or someone else. Onchain on Base — encrypted and permanent.

home.title: Time Capsule
home.tagline: Lock a message to the future. To yourself or someone else. Onchain on Base — encrypted and permanent.
home.connectHint: Connect your wallet to begin. Fee: {fee} ETH (Base mainnet).
home.wrongNetworkDesc: This app runs on the Base network.
home.quickSwapDesc: The capsule fee is paid in ETH. Swap tokens without leaving the app.
home.messagePlaceholder: What will the future you read?
home.unlockDateHint: Pick from the calendar icon on the right, or type it directly. Unlock time must be at least 15 minutes from now.
home.txStuckHint: Transaction is taking longer than 30 seconds. Check the status on Basescan above. If you haven't approved yet in your wallet, do so — otherwise Base may just be busy.

errors.switchChainFailed: You need to switch to Base. Wallet approval was rejected or chain switch failed.
errors.addressFormat: Address must start with 0x or end with .base
errors.txReverted: Transaction reverted onchain. Most common cause: unlock time is too close to now. Pick at least 15 minutes in the future and try again.

capsules.connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to view your capsules.
capsules.emptySent: You haven't sent any capsules yet.
capsules.emptyReceived: No capsules sent to you yet. Maybe someday a surprise will arrive.
capsules.emptyReady: No capsules ready to open right now.

capsuleDetail.senderHidNote: You recalled this capsule. You can still view its contents.
capsuleDetail.senderPeekNote: You wrote this — you can view the contents anytime.
capsuleDetail.selfFutureNote: You wrote this to your future self. You'll be able to open it once the unlock time arrives.
capsuleDetail.replyPrompt: {sender} sent this capsule to you. Want to reply with a future-locked capsule?
capsuleDetail.hideWindowNote: As the sender you can recall within the first hour. Time left to recall: {remaining}
